text:
Jun: seeing 2x tail latency in NA2 since the 12:02 runtime deploy, error budget burn on the edge. suspected KV cache path.
Priya: yup I see the same in Datadog, p95 for generate_token jumped from 90ms -> 220ms around 12:03 UTC.
Alex: any obvious GC/CPU spike on the hosts?
Jun: CPU stable, but threads show long serialization stalls in the kvcache marshalling layer. stack traces point to new serialization change in runtime commit c3f9d.
Maria: tagging the deploy: @alex did we roll a serialization optimization yesterday?
Alex: we landed a patch to change KV serialization from contiguous to chunked for large KV blobs. thought it would reduce mem pressure.
Priya: chunked approach added a locking path, looks like under high concurrency it serializes on the main thread. causing head-of-line.
Jun: impact: NA2 hotpool experiencing increased per-request latency and some timeouts -> spillover to NA1.
SRE-Bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-187234 (severity: high) — routing policy: failover when p95 > 200ms for 5m.
OpsBot: automatic traffic shift to NA1 started at 12:10 UTC (policy: gradual 10% steps).
Maria: immediate mitigation options? rollback runtime or flip a config to use old serializer?
Alex: I can push a quick toggle to runtime to use legacy serializer (feature flag) and patch out the locking. will build a cherry-pick.
Priya: alternative: temporarily increase batch window and reduce concurrency on NA2 to avoid lock contention. but that increases latency for small requests.
Jun: prefer toggle rollback to minimize config churn. Alex — ETA?
Alex: building cherry-pick now. if green, can roll to NA2 in ~9m.
Maria: meanwhile Ops, can you accelerate traffic shift to 30% so we stop timeouts?
OpsBot: increasing failover ramp to 30% at 12:18 UTC per request.
Jun: also start draining hotpool nodes with highest serialization stalls so new requests go to fresher workers.
Priya: adding a Prometheus alert for serial_lock_wait > 50ms to pick up any remaining hotspots.
Alex: rolled the flag at 12:28 UTC to legacy serializer on NA2. initial metrics show p95 falling back to ~95ms.
Jun: nice, watch for error spike during rollout.
SRE-Bot: automatic rollback detector: no regressions detected in 5m.
Maria: keep traffic at 30% shift for 10m then step down if stable.
Priya: opened a PR with a proper fix that removes the global lock and introduces per-shard locks — code review in flight.
Alex: will follow up with a formal postmortem and plan to revert toggle once fix lands.
Jun: good work. action items: (1) Alex — postmortem + revert plan, (2) Priya — monitor lock metric dashboards, (3) Ops — restore normal routing after stability window.
Maria: adding oncall rotation notes. thanks all :thumbsup:
